source.stem: Decide whether the following statements are correct. Mark “√” for correct answers and “×” for wrong answers. (1) Objects that can move must be living things.

mx.teacher_note: The enlarged muscle cell is an organ.

intelligence.enrichment: The levels of organisation in a living organism are ordered as Cell -> Tissue -> Organ -> Organ system -> Organism. Cells combine into higher levels -> tissues, organs, and organ systems form -> a complex organism is organised. The learner correctly applies this rule: The levels of organisation in a living organism are ordered as Cell -> Tissue -> Organ -> Organ system -> Organism. The biggest level should come first because the organism is what we can see.

spec.instruction: Write one new grades 8 Science question. Chapter: Microorganisms: friend and foe. The student must decide: Decide where a biological structure belongs in the sequence cell, tissue, organ, organ system, organism. Use an Indian school or home setting and Indian names. Keep the source language register. Change the numbers, materials, or everyday situation. Do not copy the source stem. Recalculate the key. Do not print mix-up labels, hinge codes, node codes, or the word CANDIDATE. If the stem numbers activities 1..n, every number must appear in an option (or in a structured part's first-class options). Two-tier (choose, then reason) is welcome: put A/B/C on part.options, not typed into part text.
